title: Figure 8: Graphs of Relative Angular Position and Relative Angular Velocity, "Utah" film
description: Second pair of hand-drawn curves on Douglas Aircraft Company graph paper, rotated sideways, labeled "Graph of Relative Angular Position" (radians) and "Graph of Relative Angular Velocity" (radians/second) against time in seconds. The velocity curve shows a sharp dip near 15 seconds. The header reads "Photogrammetric Analysis of 'Utah' Film," prepared by R.M.L. Baker Jr., April 8, 1956, Report No. 02, page 14.
